name: Mara's Full-Load Protocol
hypothesis: Previous mandatory deposit rules failed because agents were forced to return after accumulating only 1 or 2 items, resulting in low cargo volumes and high travel-to-harvest ratios. The evidence shows that maximizing load before returning yields better energy efficiency. This rule changes the deposition trigger from any non-zero cargo to a strict minimum of 3 items (full capacity), ensuring agents harvest three units before moving home. This maximizes food per trip distance and optimizes energy usage for the 720-step horizon.
